changelog:
Added:
- Funscript Library Matcher — keep all your scripts in one folder and The Vault links each to the matching video by filename (Settings → Library → Match Now)
- Smarter file-move detection — moving files between folders now keeps their ratings, tags, counts and history
- Period filter added to the Image/Video view
- Duplicates page now shows the file path for each entry

Changed:
- Period filter is now context-aware, only listing periods that exist within your active filters
- More of the UI prepared for translation

Fixed:
- Image viewer no longer scrolls off-screen when hovering the metadata panel
- Creator sort/filter dropdowns no longer cut off early
